name: Tailwind OKLCH
reason: Tailwind CSS v4's OKLCH palette, which the review kept as a reference. Its license isn't recorded at a pinned v4 version, and its anchors here are v3's sRGB stand-ins, so it doesn't ship. zinc and oled-black ship v3.4.17's sRGB values under MIT. Promoting this one is its own owner-approved PR.
